direct_support: V-B includes frozen ResNet18 features for chest-Xray DXC and NCC. II-A defines appearance-neighbour patient visual words and joint self-classification/restoration. This supports a testable representation hypothesis, not ViT or continual efficacy.

hypothesis: Predicting pseudo-classes shared by local crops from neighbouring base patients can add discriminative anatomical information beyond restoring identical local crops. All-seen patient/class-balanced ridge then tests transfer to new classes without future optimization.
cohort_algorithm: Only original arrivedbase10 training rows. Encode each once using fresh original full native model; derive per-patient unit mean descriptor. Select100distinct patient anchors deterministically with seed. For each anchor rank all base patients by squared Euclidean distance, stable patient tie-break, choose64distinct patients including anchor. One uniform fixed112square coordinate per word from margin8, each draw jitters top-left by at most4. Choose a patient uniformly, then one image uniformly. Groups may overlap across words. A patient can carry multiple source labels; no single patient disease label is invented.
